_description: AMAS Conflict Resolution Example: Same-Tier Conflict
_scenario: Two Tier 2 directives provide different project budgets. Explicit supersession resolves the conflict before specificity or recency.

object_a.content: Project budget: $50,000. Approved by finance committee 2026-02-15.

object_b.content: Use the revised project budget of $75,000 for this task.

resolution.rule_applied: Semantic-role admissibility for behavior; Rule 2 — Explicit Supersession for the operative budget state
resolution.reasoning: MO-DOC-015 remains evidence and cannot itself direct behavior. MO-USR-023 is an explicit Tier 2 directive and identifies the superseded object. Its narrower scope would also prevail under Rule 3 if valid supersession were absent.
resolution.action: Use $75,000 as the operative budget for the scoped task while preserving the older evidence and supersession provenance.

_fallback_note: If two same-tier directives have no valid supersession, Rule 3 applies only when one explicit scope_path strictly contains the other. If scopes tie, Rule 4 recency applies. If still unresolved, Rule 5 halts/escalates.
